mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing overcast skies at Reddan Soccer Park with temperatures at 72 degrees and an elevated air quality index of 57, plus a waning crescent moon overhead.

City officials are currently finalizing plans for upcoming site developments, including the Liberty Business Park project, while also celebrating the conclusion of the student I Voted sticker contest.
We have plenty of fun scheduled with trivia games happening today at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee, followed by local music and farmers market activities tomorrow.
In a noteworthy update, officers were busy on August 8 assisting in a vehicle rollover crash where the driver was eventually arrested for O W I.
Today's flavor is Chocolate Heath Crunch. If you miss out, tomorrow features Chocolate Covered Strawberry. Note that they are currently closed and will open at 10 AM.
